method: Analytic primary fluence (exp(-mu*z) with XCOM total attenuation, inverse-square to 105 cm, averaged over 4.9-5.1 cm) plus analog Monte Carlo photon transport in the 30 cm water cube (about 1.3e7 source photons, uniform in solid angle over the 10x10 pyramid, Phi0 = N/(Omega*105^2)). Scattered-photon track length is scored in the 1 cm radius, 0.2 cm slab (two independent runs agree within 0.4%). Interactions, energy transfer and kerma use XCOM partial coefficients and Klein-Nishina (incl. mu_en via ESTAR radiative yield). Initial electron spectra come from KN sampling of arrivals in the volume (Compton, photo, pair). Electron fluence uses continuous slowing down with ESTAR stopping powers and a Moller delta-ray source. Spencer-Attix uses restricted Bethe (ICRU 37 form, validated to ESTAR at Delta=T/2) with track-end term. D is taken as K_col (CPE, beta=1). PDD5 is from a crude electron-kernel model of the depth dose on the +/-1 cm profile; d_max is not converged, so PDD5 is a rough estimate (~78%).
data_sources: Supplied XCOM water table (/tmp/data/xcom_water.txt; coherent, incoherent, photoelectric, pair) and ESTAR water table (/tmp/data/estar_water.txt; collision/radiative stopping powers, CSDA range, radiation yield, density-effect delta). Klein-Nishina and Moller formulas, Bethe restricted stopping power with I=75 eV (water) and 85.7 eV (air) as the air data. No external data beyond these.
